newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine parliament to debate budget on June 19.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine parliament to debate budget on June 19.

text.p: Parliament in Ukraine is set to begin the second reading of the 1997 budget on June 19, speaker Olexander Moroz told deputies on Tuesday.
Moroz said he was told by the head of the budget committee that "the government and committee are preparing materials and the presentation of the budget for Thursday".
Passing this year's budget is a key condition for Ukraine to qualify for a $2.5-$3.0 billion Extended Fund Facility from the International Monetary Fund.
Ukraine has met only some of the 41 conditions to receive the loan, to succeed a $867 million stand-by credit which expired in February.

The budget, which under Ukrainian law should have been passed by January 1, forecasts gross domestic product of 100.4 billion hryvnias ($54.6 billion), a deficit of 5.7 percent of GDP, and inflation of 24.9 percent against 39.7 percent in 1996.
